newsitem.title: BELARUS: Lukashenko ready to sack Belarus central bank head.
newsitem.headline: Lukashenko ready to sack Belarus central bank head.

text.p: Belarussian President Alexander Lukashenko said he may sack National Bank Chairwoman Tamara Vinnikova, whom he appointed less than a year ago.

Lukashenko, whose anti-reform positions have led creditors such as the International Monetary Fund to suspend lending, told reporters late on Monday Belarussian commercial bankers had requested the move.

He is considering three candidates for the post, he said before an evening session of the new upper chamber of parliament, a group of conservatives loyal to Lukashenko who dismissed the previous parliament to international outcry.
He said he would name his choice to parliament for approval in the next few days and added that he is considering a large change of staff at the bank.
He appointed Vinnikova in February 1996, without approval by parliament, after her predecessor, a top economic reformer, resigned.
